review_scope: Technical review of 23 paired composed physical views after reusing floor samples within a bodega clearance check. Real queue, counterflow, checkout and Laurel witnesses are maintained separately.

images.observation: Boiler shell, gauges and small wirework align under the warm ceiling light. Left-facing fittings remain in shade.
Bookcase, shelf stock and adjacent door retain their proportions and placement. The top shelf remains dark.
The exposed cistern, floor shadows and tiled corner match. The camera crops the back of the fitting.
The same close brick face fills both views. Underexposure still limits review of the mechanism.
The main room retains its mapped floor, table and companion beside the shelf. Minor screen and reflected-color differences are visible.
The companion beam falls on the same tiled panel and curtain. The seat remains partially cropped.
The resident and furniture occupy the same room positions. The doorway retains the bright highlight of the earlier view.
The bedside reading room retains its chair, furnishings, casing and companion framing. The corner still falls off into shade.
Lamp spread, cabinetry edges and sink remain visible in both views. The current view contains a transient subtitle.
The open panel and internal knobs align beneath the same conduit. Interior recesses remain shadowed.
The Judge and the tiled floor are visible below the counter in both views. The counter leaves the animal mostly in shadow.
Lafitte, the wall photograph and shelf silhouette remain in the same places. Exposure remains low in this close view.
The upper brackets, framed wall pictures and soffit match. This canopy-heavy view leaves much of the room out of frame.
Brass mail faces and bench retain their alignment. The corner lighting remains dim.
Radiator and window stock, desk fittings and shade geometry remain legible, with the same cropped foreground.
Rails, door and roof lettering retain placement and cast the same visible shadow structure.
The rooftop tank, ladder and skyline silhouettes match. Cloud movement creates minor changes above the tank.
The lit terminal controls and comparison board remain in the same frame. The board shadow still reads against the floor.
The tile joints and exposed cistern shape align. The bowl is partly cropped in both views.
The residue remains visible in the companion light against the same boards and radiator. The companion shifts slightly.
The installed foreground form retains its edge and contact lighting under the radiator. The companion tilts slightly.
Toaster, kettle, bread and counter edges stay stable. Crumbs remain small at this framing.
The wall device and its lit dial remain visible with the same position and dark surround.
